thread:
nora: Quick summary from the usability run: people repeatedly asked "what will this key actually allow?" and hesitated on Revoke. Small fixes could remove lots of friction.

liam: What are the concrete, smallest changes we can prototype?

nora: 1) Add compact preset pills (Embeddings, Read-only, Admin-lite). Clicking expands a one-line summary inline (not a tooltip). 2) Soft-revoke with a configurable grace window (org default 10m) + undo toast. 3) After rotate, show the secret in a focusable banner with a Copy CTA and a 3-item checklist.

faye: Users liked concrete API examples. Suggest adding tiny curl examples under the summary: e.g. `curl /v1/embeddings -> 200`, `curl /v1/generate -> 403`.

own: Accessibility notes: when a preset expands, set aria-expanded and announce the summary via aria-live. When secret revealed, move focus to Copy and announce politely: "API key revealed. Press Copy to copy. This secret will not be shown again." Make revoke toast keyboard-focusable with Undo.

liam: Copy for broad scopes should be factual: "This key can create tokens and run model generation. Consider restricting scope or using a service account." Add a Learn more link.

nora: Mobile: show sticky copy bar when the secret is visible and collapse the permission grid into a single dropdown on narrow screens.

faye: Rotation banner: include a checkbox "Log rotation to audit" defaulted on for admins. Also provide a small "Force revoke now" danger action separate from Mark revoked.

own: Implementation note: backend already returns the secret one time on rotate. UI should surface it in a dismissible banner and include telemetry flag `audit=true` when the checkbox is checked.

nora: I'll update Figma frames + annotated a11y checklist and drop in #design-review. Can we pilot soft-revoke + policy preview behind a beta flag?

liam: Yes please. Thanks! :thumbsup:
